description: This file implements functionality to scalarize vector and matrix constructor arguments in shader code, transforming constructor arguments to avoid driver bugs by breaking down vectors and matrices into scalar components. It defines a traverser class that modifies the abstract syntax tree (AST) of shader code to perform this transformation.

classes.name: ScalarizeArgsTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that walks the AST of shader code to identify and scalarize vector and matrix constructor arguments, replacing them with scalar components to prevent driver bugs.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes in the AST; if a node matches scalarization pattern, it performs scalarization of vector or matrix constructor arguments.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Visits block nodes in the AST; manages block stack during traversal.

methods.name: scalarizeArgs
methods.description: Performs the actual scalarization of constructor arguments, replacing vectors/matrices with their scalar components.

methods.name: createTempVariable
methods.description: Creates a temporary variable to hold intermediate values during scalarization.
